# Third-party software

## DINO-WM / JEPA-WMs

`jepa-wms/` is an unmodified source snapshot from Meta's official
[`facebookresearch/jepa-wms`](https://github.com/facebookresearch/jepa-wms)
repository.

- Upstream commit: `13cf1d9c7e476f53c17714d2e0f1dc239a883ce0`
- Upstream commit date: 2026-04-11
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International

The snapshot preserves the upstream `LICENSE`, `THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md`, and
other attribution files. It does not include upstream Git metadata. Files in
this directory must not be presented as original work by the JEPA-Planning
team; any later modifications should be identified clearly in project
documentation and commit messages.
